# Psalm 65 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A song. A psalm of David.

**2** What mighty praise, O God, belongs to You in Zion. We will fulfill our vows to You,

**3** for You answer our prayers. All of us must come to You.

**4** Though we are overwhelmed by our sins, You forgive them all.

**5** What joy for those You choose to bring near, those who live in Your holy courts! What festivities await us inside Your holy temple.

**6** You faithfully answer our prayers with awesome deeds, O God our savior. You are the hope of everyone on earth, even those who sail on distant seas.

**7** You formed the mountains by Your power and armed Yourself with mighty strength.

**8** You quieted the raging oceans with their pounding waves and silenced the shouting of the nations.

**9** Those who live at the ends of the earth stand in awe of Your wonders. From where the sun rises to where it sets, You inspire shouts of joy.

**10** You take care of the earth and water it, making it rich and fertile. The river of God has plenty of water; it provides a bountiful harvest of grain, for You have ordered it so.

**11** You drench the plowed ground with rain, melting the clods and leveling the ridges. You soften the earth with showers and bless its abundant crops.

**12** You crown the year with a bountiful harvest; even the hard pathways overflow with abundance.

**13** The grasslands of the wilderness become a lush pasture, and the hillsides blossom with joy.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **65:9-13**: One of the most beautiful harvest poems in any language. The earth is depicted as God's garden, watered, softened, blessed — the theology of creation care.

— PNEUMA
